note: Blue faces right and red faces left on the live map (shape cue, map/spec.md §5–6). Both facings are in the sheet so the engine can face movement later. Anchor is the foot point in the cell; blit at (world_x - anchor_x, world_y - anchor_y). Hit frames apply damage; projectile_spawn.offset is pixels from the foot anchor on that frame.

skill.note: Q Keen Bolt, longer draw, marked shot

ult.note: R Horizon Volley, plant and rain

death.note: stumble, kneel, slump; last frame holds

dash.note: W Switchback: crouch, backstep 2 tiles, pivot, land

afterimages.note: Draw under the live body, above the team ring, always below HP bars and tags. Each ghost is a team-tinted faded copy of source_frame, parked at that frame's displacement.

projectile-basic-blue.note: tip on the right; flip for left facing. Anchor = tail / spawn.

projectile-skill-blue.note: tip on the right; flip for left facing. Anchor = tail / spawn.

projectile-basic-red.note: tip on the right; flip for left facing. Anchor = tail / spawn.

companion.name: falcon
companion.note: Original ivory/umber bird (matches Huntress's falcon feather). Team-tint accent is one breast pixel only. Never use objective gold. Draw above unit bodies, always below HP bars and initial tags. One bird: swoops on ult, then circles a Keen Bolt mark. Not a shoulder pet and not a projectile.

ult_swoop.units: pixels relative to caster foot anchor at 1×; flip x when the caster faces left
ult_swoop.note: Arcs over Huntress during ult frames 0–5 (500 ms), then she can send it to a mark.

mark_circle.note: Ellipse in screen space: rx = radius_tiles * tw, ry = rx * ry_scale. Centre is the target foot plus centre_offset_px (around the shoulders, below the HP bar). Use the fly loop. Facing follows the tangent.
